description: A shell script testing various scenarios of 'git init' command, covering initialization modes, configurations, repository formats, path handling, and environment interactions.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Verifies that the specified directory has correct git configuration: directory contains 'config' file, 'refs' directory, and proper 'bare' and 'worktree' settings.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command or operation fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output or files, expecting it to be found.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for equality.

methods.name: test_cmp_fspath
methods.description: Compares a file path with an expected value, resolving paths appropriately.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup or post-condition commands to run after the test.
